editorial.thesis: A food-and-drink-and-motor-trade city of about 1.5 million. Its retail is heavy on restaurants & fast food and fitness & wellness, and thin on apparel, footwear & jewellery and grocery & daily needs — and 39% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is ahead of Ahmedabad. 22.86 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.34 in Ahmedabad; 35 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 50, Domino's 31, Café Coffee Day 23.

The mapped economy leans to food & beverage. Shares of all mapped places: food & beverage 8.2% (Ahmedabad 6.3%); desserts & sweets 1.0% (Ahmedabad 0.8%); offices 15.6% (Ahmedabad 18.7%); grocery & daily needs 1.0% (Ahmedabad 1.2%). Raw counts would mislead because Ahmedabad is mapped more completely (54,281 places against 22,489), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 7 zones hold 39% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Ajwa Road alone has about 173,000 residents and 144 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is less concentrated than in Ahmedabad. 46% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ahmedabad 46%). The largest cores are Racecourse · Vidhyut Nagar Colony (2,431 places) and Khanderao · Madanzampa (1,150).

The widest brand gaps against Ahmedabad. Apollo Pharmacy 50 outlets vs 83; Café Coffee Day 23 outlets vs 46; Havmor 12 outlets vs 35. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ahmedabad, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Ajwa Road and Racecourse · Vidhyut Nagar Colony are the largest zones by residents (173,000 and 140,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 46% of all commercial places, and Racecourse · Vidhyut Nagar Colony alone lists 2,431.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Racecourse · Vidhyut Nagar Colony holds 56 of the 352 tracked chain outlets, and Subhanpura adds 32.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Racecourse · Vidhyut Nagar Colony and Ajwa Road lead on education places (188 and 150, with 73 and 59 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Ajwa Road and Atladara. The blue cores include Racecourse · Vidhyut Nagar Colony.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (54,281 places in Ahmedabad against 22,489 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ahmedabad; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ahmedabad, Vadodara's mapped places over-index on food & beverage (8.2% vs 6.3%), desserts & sweets (1.0% vs 0.8%), automotive (3.3% vs 2.7%) and under-index on offices (15.6% vs 18.7%), grocery & daily needs (1.0% vs 1.2%), shops & retail (13.3% vs 14.7%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 352 outlets of 35 tracked national brands within 8 km — 22.86 per lakh residents against Ahmedabad's 14.34 (624 outlets of 38 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ahmedabad are Apollo Pharmacy (50 vs 83); Café Coffee Day (23 vs 46); Havmor (12 vs 35). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ahmedabad's, so low means thin by Ahmedabad's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Vadodara's age mix against Ahmedabad: children (0–14) 24.6% vs 23.9%, 15–24 17.8% vs 19.3%, working age 49.0% vs 48.8%, 60+ 8.6% vs 8.0%. Under-25s are 42% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.9% of mapped places against 4.4% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 31 (Ahmedabad 45), Subway 22 (Ahmedabad 34), McDonald's 19 (Ahmedabad 27), Pizza Hut 17 (Ahmedabad 20). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.2% of mapped places against 1.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 23 (Ahmedabad 46), Starbucks 4 (Ahmedabad 11), Chai Sutta Bar 2 (Ahmedabad 3). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 1.0% of mapped places against 0.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Havmor 12 (Ahmedabad 35), Baskin Robbins 5 (Ahmedabad 13). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.0% of mapped places against 1.2% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 10 (Ahmedabad 28), DMart 6 (Ahmedabad 13), Spencer's 4 (Ahmedabad 2), Big Bazaar 3 (Ahmedabad 3). No mapped outlet in either city: Vishal Mega Mart.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.5% of mapped places against 0.6% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 50 (Ahmedabad 83). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 4.5% of mapped places against 5.5% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Raymond 20 (Ahmedabad 34), Bata 17 (Ahmedabad 29), Reliance Trends 8 (Ahmedabad 26), Westside 7 (Ahmedabad 9).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.9% of mapped places against 8.1% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 2.6% of mapped places against 2.3% in Ahmedabad — above its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 4.8% of mapped places against 3.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
